title: Count of functions computed by small DAG circuits
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $S$, the number of Boolean functions on $n$ variables computed by well-formed fan-in-two directed acyclic circuits of size at most $S$ is at most $(S+1)\bigl(3(S+1)^2\bigr)^S S$.
